_: The colour regions of each drawn creature, keyed by the skin's full name (<mount id>/<skin folder>: saddleup.dragon/default; tools/skins/skinroots.py), (docs/mount-colours.md 2.6), as rules over a colour's hue (degrees), saturation and value (0..1): the first region whose rule matches wins, in the order written; a colour no rule matches is Coat. tools/skins/skin_colors.py applies them to the pictures (front/ included) and writes each skin's [Colors]. Edit here, never in the script.

saddleup-dragon.dragon/default._: Coat = the red scales and the wing; Muzzle = the golden belly (its own row on the page, Second tone: the user wants to tweak it apart from the scales, 2026-10-20); Dark = outlines, horns and back spikes (bone); Eye = the yellow eye. Dark first (the bone's low-saturation golds), then Eye (the yellow and its highlight, which the belly's hue range would also take), then Muzzle. Since 2026-11-04 (docs/mount-colours.md 7.11): Dark = the outline only (1C060C, its lit top edge 2E0C14, the one dark pixel 1E0A0A), with no row (line art); the bone golds (the horns and the back spikes) Coat here, which keeps the belly's hue range off them, a part of their own in the cfg ([Tone.horns]); the body's deepest shade 280810 and the wings' ribs 260828 Coat (they were Dark by value).

saddleup-critters.rat/default._: Coat = the grey fur; Muzzle = the pink tail, ears and nose; Dark = outlines; Eye = the red eye.

saddleup-critters.snail/default._: Coat = the green body; Muzzle = the brown shell; Eye = the eyes on the stalks' tips (1E1A16, a step under the outline in value; 2026-11-04: a part of their own, docs/second-tone.md 8); Dark = the outline and the stalks' stripes (one colour).

saddleup-critters.worm/default._: Coat = the pink skin; Eye = the eyes (18080C); Muzzle = the mouth (42121A); Dark = the outline. The eyes and the mouth are colours of their own a few steps from the outline in value, each in a colour-cube cell apart from it (the worm has more colours than the exact swap takes) (2026-11-04: parts of their own, docs/second-tone.md 8).

saddleup.gerry/default._: The game's skull, read at run time: its colours come from the in-game export (BepInEx/GK2-asset-probe/game-skins/saddleup.gerry/default, the Mounts tab's Export button); Dark = the sockets and cracks, the bone is Coat.
